verdict.rationale: Helicone documents a first-party webhooks feature that sends notifications when LLM requests complete, for workflow automation, response scoring, and integration with external systems. Webhooks can be filtered so only requests matching all specified properties trigger them. Slack/email alerts are not credited here, since they are chat/email notifications rather than webhooks. Missing for 10: evidence of event types beyond request completion, details on endpoint registration, payload signing and retries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
